definitions.explanation: In good health, physically and mentally well.

examples.japanese: {健|すこ}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ほしい→ほしい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: I hope you grow up healthy.
examples.notes: Often used in well-wishes for children

examples.japanese: {健|すこ}やかな⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I live a healthy daily life.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{子|こ}さん→お子さん：01564_okosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{健|すこ}やかな⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{祈|いの}りします→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
examples.english: I pray for your child's healthy growth.

notes:
{健|すこ}やか is a na-adjective describing good health and vitality, often with a nuance of wholesome well-being.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {健|すこ}やかな + noun
- Adverbial: {健|すこ}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {健|すこ}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧: to grow up healthy
- {健|すこ}やかな⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧: healthy growth
- {健|すこ}やかな⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧: healthy daily life

USAGE:
This is a somewhat formal or literary word often used:
- In well-wishes for children's health and growth
- In formal greetings, blessings, and ceremonial contexts
- On cards for births, coming-of-age, and other celebrations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧: energetic, healthy (more casual)
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧: healthy (more neutral/common)
